notes: Installed a second Pennyshaver on turn 5 (trashing the first), then clicked for credits on turns 13-15 at 16-28 credits with 5 cards instead of contesting the many-times-advanced Server 1 card. Ran into Karuna without a working breaker twice each on turns 16 and 18, losing Shibboleth, Tremolo and Revolver, and turn 22 ran a known Saisentan with a 2-card grip and flatlined.

Left R&D unprotected until turn 5 against a Runner making four R&D runs a turn, and only added Drafter and Vertigo (no ETR) there, so two Project Ingatan and Superconducting Hub were stolen from R&D. Turns 7-13 were spent recurring Hedge Fund to hoard 70+ credits instead of icing up or scoring, though it eventually won with Seamless Launch in Server 5.

Clicked for credits on nearly every click from turn 1 to turn 11, reaching 44 credits with 5 cards in grip and never installing a single card. Made one breakerless run into Server 1 on turn 6 and otherwise let the Corp score Divested Trust, two Above the Law and Transport Monopoly from one remote without a contest.

Iced HQ twice on turn 1 while R&D stayed open, then sank 6 credits into Ansel 1.0 on turn 3 and sat at 0-1 credits for the rest of the game, unable to rez the three HQ ice, so two Megaprix Qualifiers were stolen from HQ on turns 12 and 14. The Ansel install sub kept pointlessly trashing and reinstalling Server 1 ice (turns 10-11), but the Ablative Barrier remote plus Seamless Launch still scored ADT, Hub, Méliès and Ingatan for the win.

Strong tempo: Carpe Diem took Fujii Asset Retrieval on turn 1, a plain HQ run took Yagi-Uda on turn 3, and Shibboleth got through to Longevity Serum for the turn-6 win. The turn-4 Tread Lightly into a naked Jinteki remote with a 2-card grip and the turn-5 Server 1 run with 2 cards were risky against Urtica Cipher, but neither was lethal.

Put Project Ingatan in Server 2 on turn 4 behind a Hagen that Marjanah broke, then on turn 5 put a second Ingatan in the same server with no new ice, and both were stolen. After scoring Méliès, turns 8-11 were spent clicking for credits with 15-27 credits and a full hand (discarding each turn) instead of icing R&D beyond one Vertigo, and the Runner took ADT from R&D for the win.

The Buzzsaw/Banner/Leech plan worked, with steady R&D pressure through Afshar that won it on turn 19, but there were many low-value empty Archives runs (turns 4, 9, 11, 16, 18) and repeat HQ runs at 2 credits each through Banner. Playing Privileged Access on turn 11 at 0 credits left a tag the Runner could not clear, and the Corp trashed three installed cards; the Runner also never contested the Above the Law that was scored from Server 1 on turns 13-14.

Never installed a breaker or anything else, clicking for credits up to 44 credits with 5 cards in grip from turn 2 to turn 11. Its only runs were breakerless facechecks into Tree Line and Descent (turns 3, 8, 9, 10), while the Corp scored Transport Monopoly, Divested Trust and two Above the Law from lightly iced remotes.

On turn 3 the Corp spent its last 2 credits trashing Telework Contract right after installing Post-Truth Dividend behind ice it could not rez, so it was stolen; Tomorrow's Headline behind a lone Ping went the same way on turn 4. From turns 7-10 and 18-19 it repeatedly spent 2 credits per click trashing resources while at 0-3 credits, keeping itself broke for most of the game. It still won slowly with Next Big Thing, Tomorrow's Headline and Embedded Reporting against a weak Runner.

The tag pressure (Oppo Research, VSA, Funhouse) drained the Runner's clicks and credits well, and fast-advancing Post-Truth Dividend on turns 10 and 25 was smart. However, it put Embedded Reporting in Server 2 on turn 14 behind ice the Runner already passed every turn, and on turn 18 in Server 5 behind a single Ping (Gauss breaks it), and both were stolen. The double Oppo Research on turn 19 spent 7 credits with no follow-up punishment.

Every remote was protected only by non-ETR ice (Unsmiling Tsarevna, VSA, Ping), so Tomorrow's Headline on turn 4, Embedded Reporting on turn 8 and Next Big Thing on turn 9 (installed into the same server right after the previous steal) were all stolen. It sat on 14-20 credits, clicking for credits on turn 6, instead of finding an ETR ice for the scoring server.

Won through relentless breakerless R&D runs, eating Hammer's tags and paying to clear them, which was crude but effective against a passive Corp (Above the Law turn 1, Divested Trust turn 3, Transport Monopoly turn 9, Above the Law turn 11). It wasted resources by installing Leech (turn 7) and Stargate via Privileged Access (turn 8) and then running straight back into Hammer, which trashed them, and it could not contest the SDS Drone Deployment scored on turns 10-11.

Installed and advanced Next Big Thing on turn 5 in Server 1 behind just a Ping, and it was stolen as soon as Gauss came down. It spent 7 credits on the double Oppo Research on turn 6 and then 2 credits per click repeatedly trashing resources on turns 8-10 and 16, sitting at 0 credits for many turns. It never added ice to an HQ guarded only by Ping, so Post-Truth Dividend (turn 10) and the game-winning Tomorrow's Headline (turn 16) were stolen from HQ.

On turn 1 it ran Transfer of Wealth into unrezzed HQ ice against a Jinteki net-damage deck, and Anemone emptied the grip. It then ran R&D with 0 cards in grip, even though Moon Pool had just revealed Fujii Asset Retrieval being shuffled into R&D, stole Fujii and was flatlined by its 2 net damage.

Good pressure: it took Hybrid Release and Longevity Serum from Archives on turn 2, broke Saisentan with Revolver, and won on turn 11 through steady R&D/HQ runs. Minor issues: the turn-1 facecheck into Anemone cost 3 cards, the turn-8 Jailbreak through an unbroken Anemone lost Revolver to the damage, and the turn-10 Carpe Diem run on Archives was jacked out of.

On turn 3 it installed Méliès City Luxury Line in Server 1 and advanced it twice, leaving 2 credits, too few to rez the 4-cost Hagen protecting it, and the Runner walked in. It then put Megaprix (turn 4) and Project Ingatan (turn 5, at 0 credits) into the same one-ice server, which Marjanah had already broken, and never played an economy card, losing on turn 5.

A fast start (Divested Trust from R&D and HQ, Transport Monopoly through Hammer on turn 5) was followed by turns 6-16 of near-useless play: repeated runs on an empty Archives (turns 6, 8, 9, 11, 13, 16, 17) and HQ runs paying for Banner to see the same Envelopment and Descent. It hovered at 0-5 credits while avoiding R&D, the server that eventually gave the SDS Drone Deployment win on turn 17 against a Corp doing nothing.

Kept Méliès City Luxury Line in an HQ guarded only by an Ansel 1.0 it could not afford to rez (turn 2 steal), and later lost a second Project Ingatan from HQ (turn 15). Turns 8-12 and 18-21 were spent clicking for credits with 16-31 credits and a full hand, discarding every turn, instead of adding ice or installing agendas. The final Megaprix in Server 2 had only Hagen as ETR ice, and Marjanah broke it.

Lost an early Project Ingatan from HQ (turn 2) and was broke on turns 3-8, but used Bloop's Harmonic derez/rez swap well to keep punishing runs and trashing Runner cards. Once Petty Cash and Hedge Fund came online it scored Megaprix, ADT (with Ansel stopping the steal on turn 11), another Megaprix and Ingatan from a remote behind Ansel and Hagen.

Hammering the unprotected R&D four times a turn on turns 1-6 was right and stole Divested Trust and Above the Law. After Buzzsaw failed on Tree Line (turns 7-8), it clicked for credits on every click from turn 9 to 15, reaching 38 credits with 5 cards and no new breakers or runs. Meanwhile the Corp scored Transport Monopoly, Above the Law and the winning Divested Trust from remotes.
